name: std::ranges::contiguous_range
intro: The contiguous_range concept is a refinement of range for which ranges::begin returns a model of contiguous_iterator and the customization point ranges::data is usable.

sections.title: Semantic requirements
sections.text: T models contiguous_range only if given an expression e such that decltype((e)) is T&, std::to_address(ranges::begin(e)) == ranges::data(e).

summary: The contiguous_range concept is a refinement of range for which ranges::begin returns a model of contiguous_iterator and the customization point ranges::data is usable.
